title: What the live paper record shows
description: The engines' own state, read from the running record: what is open, what closed, and what the market filter is doing right now.
body:
This page reports a paper record. Every position is simulated, no real orders are placed anywhere in this record, and one closed trade cannot say whether a strategy works. The figures below are the engines' own state at the time of the snapshot.

## What the record contains

- Live starts: v005 counts its live record from 1 October 2026, and v006 counts from 9 October 2026.
- htf-rsi-v007: 0 positions open on paper, 4 closed trades so far, average null net per trade.
- trend-daily-v005: 0 positions open on paper, 6 closed trades so far, average -13.22% net per trade.
- trend-daily-v006: 0 positions open on paper, 7 closed trades so far, average -13.34% net per trade.
- Snapshot read at 2026-11-09T08:49:37.794Z.

The closed-trade averages are the only summary figures given for those trades. A null average for htf-rsi-v007 means the record does not present a numeric average for its 4 closed trades.

## The first closed trade

- First live signal: an ATOM entry at 2.066 after the 10 October 2026 daily close.
- Exit: below the 10-day low at the 18 October 2026 close, at 1.703.
- Result: -17.9% after the 30 bps round trip.

The rule in view is an exit below the 10-day low, and the measurement is the recorded -17.9% after costs. That outcome is one paper trade, so it shows what happened to that position under the rule rather than a judgement on the strategy. The record also notes that in testing, losses were common and the average winner was roughly +19%, so a losing start is the expected case rather than a surprise.

## The open position

- NEAR entry at 5.896 on 12 October 2026 has been open since.
- No exit for that position is shown in this snapshot.

NEAR is the named open position in the live record, while ATOM is the completed one. The record gives no exit price and no result for NEAR, so treating it as a finished outcome would be premature. Its result is not yet measured.

## Market filter and near breakouts

- trend-daily-v005: the Bitcoin market filter is off, and 0 positions are open on paper.
- trend-daily-v006: the Bitcoin market filter is off, and 0 positions are open on paper.
- Closest to the 20-day breakout in both engines: ZECUSDT is 8.28% below its high, TRXUSDT is 9.36% below its high, and BNBUSDT is 9.82% below its high.

The filter being off and the zero open positions appear together in the record. The distance-to-high figures show how far those names are from the breakout level; they are not a forecast of entry, and no entry for those names is recorded.

## How to read this record

The record is paper only, and it updates continuously. The same numbers appear on the performance page, in the signal log, and in the status posted to the channel. A single closed trade, including the ATOM result of -17.9%, does not prove or disprove a strategy. The open NEAR position has no measured result yet. The trend engines show -13.22% and -13.34% average net per trade over 6 and 7 closed trades, which is a small sample. The htf-rsi-v007 record shows 4 closed trades with a null average, so no numeric average is available there. Read together, the record shows what is open, what has closed, and what the filter is allowing at the snapshot time, without projection.
